title: QAROS ROS plugin registrations (ros-plugins.json)
description: Per-user file that tells QAROS which qar_rviz_streaming builds exist for which ROS 2 distribution. Windows: %APPDATA%\Quaternar\ros-plugins.json. Linux: ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/quaternar/ros-plugins.json. Written by scripts/register-qaros-plugin.{ps1,sh} (source local) and by QAROS (source prebuilt). Writers keep fields and records they do not know.

version.description: Format version. A writer that does not know the version leaves the file unchanged.

plugins.description: At most one record per (distro, platform, source).

platform.description: Operating system and architecture the plugin was built for.

source.description: local: a hand build registered by the register script. prebuilt: a release asset QAROS downloaded and unpacked. A local record wins over a prebuilt one for the same distro and platform.

ros_root.description: Absolute path of the ROS 2 distribution root: the folder with the setup script (local_setup.bat / setup.bash) and rviz2. Sourced before the overlay.

prefix.description: Absolute path of the overlay prefix that holds the plugin (share/ament_index, bin or lib, share/qar_rviz_streaming, local_setup.*).

plugin_version.description: Version of the qar_rviz_streaming package (its package.xml).

c_api_header_sha256.description: SHA-256 (lower-case hex) of the QarOS C header qar_streaming.h the plugin was compiled against (qaros: qar-streaming-c/include/qar_streaming.h). QAROS compares it with its own runtime.

registered_at.description: UTC time of the registration, ISO 8601 with a Z suffix.

qaros_version.description: Optional. For prebuilt records: the QAROS release the asset belongs to.
